'''Brett Chaiyawat''' won the [[1997 Calamari Regionals (Sydney)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 16 years of age and reside in Sydney, Australia. I work at McDonalds, and play Star Wars CCG with my friend Ken Tan. Also, I get help with deck ideas from Ivan, Mark and Joe."

"Likes: (aside from playing Star Wars CCG), Basketball (Penny Rules!), Star Wars in general, surfing the net, playing computer games, playing cards, listening to music, Mariah Carey, and Spice Girls (yes I admit it!!!)."

"Favourite Star Wars character: Leia (gotta love those buns)."

"Favourite Star Wars CCG character: Wedge Antilles (he appeared for 3 secs, but is the most versatile)."

"Favourite Star Wars CCG card: Monnok - It won the regional for me (I drained for 1 a turn with it and used it to get rid of his EBO)."

"Star Wars CCG cards I'm looking forward to: Boussh (please make it!) and Mon Cal Cruisers."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chaiyawatt.html Brett Chaiyawat], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427144534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chaiyawatt.html Internet Archive]</ref>
